usage_md:
# @proxypilot/email — provider-agnostic transactional email Outbound email for the app with **Resend** (HTTPS API), **any SMTP server** (dependency-free client: implicit TLS :465, STARTTLS :587, AUTH PLAIN/LOGIN), or a **console** dev sink — selected by configuration, not code. Secrets (Resend API key / SMTP password) are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM via `EMAIL_MASTER_SECRET`); every send lands in an append-only `email_log` (recipient, subject, provider, outcome — no bodies). ## Mount (three steps) ```ts import { initEmail, loadEmailConfigFromEnv, adminEmailRoutes, sendEmail, } from './email/index.js'; // 1) Inject the app's Drizzle client + config once at boot. initEmail({ db, config: loadEmailConfigFromEnv() }); // 2) Mount the admin router BEHIND YOUR ADMIN GUARD (it does no auth itself). app.use('/api/admin/email', requirePermission('admin.settings'), adminEmailRoutes); // 3) Send from anywhere. await sendEmail({ to: 'user@example.com', subject: 'Welcome', html: '

Hi!

' }); ``` Run `migrations/0001_email.sql` with the app's other migrations (the platform renumbers on install). ## Which provider sends? 1. The **admin-configured connection** (`PUT /api/admin/email` from the settings UI) when one is saved — operators point the app at Resend or any SMTP server at runtime, no redeploy. 2. Otherwise the **environment** (`EMAIL_PROVIDER` + the matching vars below). 3. Otherwise **console**: the message is logged server-side and recorded in `email_log` — flows that email links (verification, invites) stay testable before a provider exists. ### Resend (recommended default) ``` EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend EMAIL_FROM=app@yourdomain.com # domain must be verified in Resend RESEND_API_KEY=re_... # or save it via the admin UI (encrypted) ``` ### Any SMTP server ``` EMAIL_PROVIDER=smtp EMAIL_FROM=app@yourdomain.com SMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com SMTP_PORT=587 # 465 for implicit TLS SMTP_SECURITY=starttls # implicit | starttls | none (local relays only) SMTP_USERNAME=app@yourdomain.com SMTP_PASSWORD=... # or save via the admin UI (encrypted) ``` `EMAIL_MASTER_SECRET` must be a real secret in production — it encrypts the stored provider credential. ## Admin API (mount-guarded) | Method | Path | What | | --- | --- | --- | | GET `/` | saved connection (secret redacted to `has_secret`) + the provider that would send right now | | PUT `/` | save provider config; `secret` is write-only (omit = keep, `""` = clear) | | POST `/test` | send a probe (to `{to}` or self-addressed) and stamp the outcome | | GET `/log` | recent sends, newest first | ## Egress (fenced builds) Sending happens from the app container, so the fence needs an egress grant: `api.resend.com:443` for Resend, or your SMTP host:port for SMTP. The connection declares this in the contract (`connections`) so the platform prompts for the grant; delivery is LIVE-verified by the operator (POST `/test`) — the fence cannot confirm real-world delivery. ## Wiring the auth module's verification emails The auth component's external-signup flow takes a `sendEmail` hook — hand it this module: ```ts initAuth({ db, config: authConfig, hooks: { sendEmail: (m) => sendEmail(m), verificationUrl: (token) => `${APP_BASE_URL}/verify-email?token=${token}`, }, }); ``` ## Notes - One message per call; retries/queues belong to the caller (check `result.ok` / `result.error`). - `email_log` never stores bodies (they may carry PII/links). - The SMTP client refuses to send credentials over an unencrypted connection.

files.content:
-- 0001_email — transactional email module (@proxypilot/email).
-- Provider-agnostic outbound email: Resend (HTTPS API), any SMTP server, or a
-- console/dev sink. Connection settings are admin-configured at runtime and
-- encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM via EMAIL_MASTER_SECRET) — the same posture as
-- the auth module's LDAPS settings. Every send lands in email_log (append-only)
-- so delivery is auditable without provider dashboards.

-- The configured outbound connection (one row per tenant; single-tenant apps
-- use 'default'). Secrets (SMTP password / Resend API key) live ONLY in the
-- ciphertext columns; plaintext never touches the database.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS email_connections (
  id                 SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default',
  provider           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'console', -- resend | smtp | console
  from_email         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  from_name          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  -- SMTP-only connection fields (host/port/mode/username are not secrets).
  smtp_host          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  smtp_port          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 587,
  smtp_security      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'starttls', -- implicit | starttls | none
  smtp_username      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  -- AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the provider secret (SMTP password or Resend API
  -- key), base64; nonce alongside. Empty when no secret has been stored yet.
  secret_ciphertext  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  secret_nonce       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  status             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unconfigured', -- unconfigured | configured | verified | failed
  last_test_at       TIMESTAMPTZ,
  last_test_error    TEXT,
  updated_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS email_connections_tenant_uq ON email_connections (tenant_id);

-- Append-only send log. No message bodies (they may carry PII) — recipient,
-- subject, provider, outcome. Enough to answer "did the verification email to
-- X go out, and through what".
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS email_log (
  id          SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default',
  to_email    TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  provider    TEXT NOT NULL,
  status      TEXT NOT NULL, -- sent | failed
  error       TEXT,
  message_id  TEXT,
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS email_log_tenant_created_idx ON email_log (tenant_id, created_at DESC);

import { pgTable, serial, text, integer, timestamp } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core';

// Drizzle schema for the email module (migration 0001_email.sql). Drizzle is
// the only data-access path. Secrets live ONLY as AES-256-GCM ciphertext.

export const emailConnections = pgTable('email_connections', {
  id: serial('id').primaryKey(),
  tenantId: text('tenant_id').notNull().default('default'),
  provider: text('provider').notNull().default('console'),
  fromEmail: text('from_email').notNull().default(''),
  fromName: text('from_name').notNull().default(''),
  smtpHost: text('smtp_host').notNull().default(''),
  smtpPort: integer('smtp_port').notNull().default(587),
  smtpSecurity: text('smtp_security').notNull().default('starttls'),
  smtpUsername: text('smtp_username').notNull().default(''),
  secretCiphertext: text('secret_ciphertext').notNull().default(''),
  secretNonce: text('secret_nonce').notNull().default(''),
  status: text('status').notNull().default('unconfigured'),
  lastTestAt: timestamp('last_test_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  lastTestError: text('last_test_error'),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }).defaultNow().notNull(),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).defaultNow().notNull(),
});

export const emailLog = pgTable('email_log', {
  id: serial('id').primaryKey(),
  tenantId: text('tenant_id').notNull().default('default'),
  toEmail: text('to_email').notNull(),
  subject: text('subject').notNull().default(''),
  provider: text('provider').notNull(),
  status: text('status').notNull(),
  error: text('error'),
  messageId: text('message_id'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).defaultNow().notNull(),
});
